shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -80 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.jsx" -o -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.html" \) -print | grep -v node_modules | head -100

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html AGENTS.md tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui -R | head -50; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; rg -n -i "toast" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toast* 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -ipath "*toast*" -name "*.d.ts" | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster; cat $D/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts $D/hooks/useToaster.d.ts $D/types.d.ts $D/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts $D/Toaster.d.ts $D/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/toaster-singleton.d.ts; cat $D/Toast/Toast.d.ts | head -60; curl -sS -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt | head -c 500; echo; echo EXIT=$?
cd /tmp && mkdir -p gravity-docs-eval && curl -sS -m 30 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o gravity-docs-eval/llms.txt && rg -n -i "toast" gravity-docs-eval/llms.txt | head -40

cd /tmp && curl -sS -m 30 https://unpkg.com/@gravity-ui/uikit@7.51.1/build/docs/components/Toaster.md -o gravity-docs-eval/Toaster.md; wc -l gravity-docs-eval/Toaster.md; head -c 9000 gravity-docs-eval/Toaster.md

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build; rg -n "view|size" $U/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "ButtonView =" -A3 $U/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head; rg -n "position|bottom|top|right|left" $U/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/*.css $U/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/*.scss 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $U/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/; rg -n "position" $U/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js | head -5; rg -n "spacing-4|--g-spacing-" $U/styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls $U/styles | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; ls $U/styles; rg -n "spacing-4" $U/styles/*.css | head -3; rg -n "toaster" -i $U/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.css 2>/dev/null | head -3; rg -n "g-toaster|position: fixed" $U/build/esm/components/Toaster -r '$0' --glob '*.css' | head -10; rg -n "BUTTON_VIEWS = " -A3 $U/build/esm/components/Button/constants.js | head -8
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat
